plan.goal: Clone jogável de Minecraft (React 18 + three.js + Vite): motor puro em src/engine/ seguindo o contrato de task.md, com testes passando, e UI completa (menu, mundo em chunks, controles, HUD, inventário/crafting, save) ligada em src/main.jsx.

steps.step: Implementar src/engine/blocks.js (constantes de ids, tabela de blocos, STICK/WOODEN_PICKAXE/STONE_PICKAXE/COAL, getBlock, getItem, isSolid, isTransparent; RangeError em id desconhecido; hardness Infinity para água e bedrock) e src/engine/daynight.js (DAY_LENGTH, skyState com mod positivo, daylight contínuo em [0.15,1], isNight em (0.5,1)). Conferir test/engine.test.js.

Implementar src/engine/noise.js (hashSeed 32 bits sem sinal para número/string, createRng, createNoise2D contínuo em [-1,1] com value/gradient noise suavizado) e src/engine/mining.js (canHarvest, breakTime, dropsFor conforme fórmula e velocidades da spec).

Implementar src/engine/inventory.js (todas as funções puras: addItem com stacks/maxStack/leftover, removeFromSlot, selectSlot com RangeError, scrollSelection com volta, moveStack com junta/troca/sobra, selectedItem) e src/engine/crafting.js (craft para 2x2/3x3 com receitas deslocáveis, item extra invalida, receitas só 3x3 das picaretas; consumeIngredients pura).

Implementar src/engine/world.js: chunkIndex, generateChunk (altura via ruído em [SEA_LEVEL-8, SEA_LEVEL+20] sem emenda entre chunks, camadas, água, minérios com ao menos 1 COAL_ORE por chunk, árvores contidas no chunk, modo flat), createWorld com cache e mapa de edições, getBlockAt (coords negativas, y<0 BEDROCK, y>=64 AIR), setBlockAt (RangeError, reverter ao gerado apaga edição), getSurfaceHeight, serialize/deserialize (JSON ordenado x,y,z, versão 1).

Implementar src/engine/mesher.js (buildChunkMesh com culling por vizinho AIR ou transparente diferente, vizinhos entre chunks, bordas y<0/y>63, 4 vértices/6 índices por face, normais, winding anti-horário, UVs no tile do atlas; split opaque/transparent) e src/engine/raycast.js (DDA Amanatides&Woo, ignora AIR/WATER, face normal, distance euclidiana, origem dentro de sólido, direção não normalizada). Exportar de um módulo do motor o layout do atlas (tile por bloco/face) para reuso pela UI.

Implementar src/engine/physics.js: constantes, createPlayer, collidesAt, canPlaceBlock, stepPlayer pura (subpassos de 0.05, colisão por eixo Y,X,Z, pés exatos no topo do bloco, pulo de 1 bloco, sneak sem cair da borda, água, voo, sprint só para frente, diagonal normalizada). Rodar `npm test` e corrigir até passar todo o motor, incluindo casos de borda além dos visíveis.

Criar src/render/: atlas.js (canvas 16x16 por tile gerado em código, NearestFilter, tiles de grama topo/lado/base, tronco topo/lado, ícones, texturas de rachadura), chunkManager.js (carregar/descarregar por distância, fila com poucas malhas por frame, materiais opaco/água semitransparente/alphaTest para folha e vidro, remesh de chunk e vizinhos ao editar), sky.js (cor do céu, sol, lua, luzes ambiente/direcional, neblina por skyState).

Criar src/game/ (loop e controles): GameCanvas.jsx com cena three, câmera, pointer lock, mouse look com pitch ±89°, teclas WASD/espaço/Shift/Ctrl/duplo W/F, integração com stepPlayer, spawn em getSurfaceHeight+1, raycast com alcance 5 e wireframe, mineração segurando botão com progresso de rachadura e drop no inventário, colocar com canPlaceBlock e consumo, botão do meio, roda e teclas 1-9, overlay de água, spawn no centro.

Criar src/ui/ em React: Menu.jsx (título, seed aleatória, Novo mundo, Continuar só com save, slider 2-8 padrão 4), HUD.jsx (mira, hotbar com ícones do atlas e quantidade, nome do item por 2 s), InventoryScreen.jsx (36 slots, crafting 2x2, clicar pega/solta via moveStack, resultado via craft/consumeIngredients), CraftingTable 3x3, PauseMenu.jsx (Continuar, Salvar, Sair), DebugOverlay.jsx (F3: FPS, XYZ, chunk, direção, bloco mirado, seed, hora), CSS caprichado em src/styles.css.

Criar src/game/save.js (chave mc-mvp-save, guarda serializeWorld, posição, yaw/pitch, inventário, hora do dia; autosave a cada 30 s e ao pausar; load para Continuar) e ligar tudo em src/main.jsx/App.jsx (estados menu/jogando/pausado, E, Esc, F3, bancada com botão direito). Rodar `npm test` e `npm run build`, e verificar `npm run dev` sem erros no console.

doneWhen: `npm test` passa, incluindo casos de borda do contrato de cada módulo do motor.
`npm run dev` abre menu com seed aleatória, Novo mundo, Continuar (só com save) e slider 2-8.
Mundo infinito por seed carrega e descarrega chunks sem travar, com água semitransparente, folhas e vidro recortados, atlas gerado em código.
Controles funcionam: olhar, andar, pular, sneak, correr, voar, minerar com rachadura, colocar, pegar bloco, alcance 5 com wireframe.
Hotbar, inventário de 36 slots com crafting 2x2, bancada 3x3, pausa, F3 e overlay de água funcionam.
Ciclo dia/noite com céu, sol, lua, luz e neblina; autosave em 30 s e ao pausar, e Continuar restaura mundo, posição, olhar, inventário e hora.
Nenhum erro no console; motor em src/engine/ sem importar three, react nem DOM.
risks: Contratos de borda do motor (physics, mesher culling, geração sem emenda, edições revertidas) têm testes ocultos; ler test/engine.test.js e seguir a spec literalmente.
Geração de chunks e remalhagem podem travar o frame; limitar trabalho por frame e reusar buffers.
Winding e UVs do mesher errados geram faces invisíveis ou texturas trocadas; o atlas precisa ter layout compartilhado entre motor e render.
Física: tunelamento, pulo de 2 blocos, sneak na borda e pés exatamente no topo exigem cuidado com epsilon e ordem dos eixos.
Pointer lock, estado de teclado e React re-renderizando no loop; manter estado do jogo em refs e só atualizar HUD quando mudar.
Escopo grande: entregar o motor testado primeiro, depois a UI incrementalmente.

notes: Esc/pointer lock integration: the browser uses Esc to release pointer lock, and the page may never see that keydown. Open the pause menu from the `pointerlockchange` event when the lock is lost and no other screen (inventory/crafting) is open. Also call `exitPointerLock` when opening E or the crafting table, and re-lock only on click when going back. `preventDefault` F3 and the hotbar/Space keys to avoid browser side effects.

Ctrl+W closes the tab in Chrome and can't be blocked by `preventDefault`. Make the double-W tap the main sprint path, and check sprint with Ctrl held before W, or note the limitation in a comment or README. Also accept `sprint` only when `forward` is true, in both the UI and `stepPlayer`.

Inventory/crafting UI: 'clicar pega e solta pilhas' needs a held 'cursor stack' state (pick up, drop, swap, merge up to `maxStack`); `moveStack` between slots is not enough. Clicking the result slot should add the result to the cursor or inventory and apply `consumeIngredients` once. When E/the table/Esc closes, return the cursor stack and the contents of the 2x2/3x3 grid to the inventory with `addItem`, so nothing is lost.

Purity and determinism in the engine: `stepPlayer`, all of `inventory.js` and `consumeIngredients` must copy arrays and stacks (`position`/`velocity`/`slots`/`{id,count}`), never mutate in place. Hidden tests are likely to freeze inputs or compare them before and after. Ore and tree placement must come only from the seed plus chunk/world coordinates, never `Math.random`. Keep chunk edits in a separate map from the generation cache, so rendering can unload chunks without losing edits.

Save/Continue: keep the seed exactly as entered (a string from the menu field) through `serializeWorld`/`deserializeWorld`. Save and restore the game clock (in seconds) used by `skyState`, plus yaw/pitch/flying. Wrap `localStorage` reads and `JSON.parse` in `try/catch` (a corrupt or wrong-version save hides 'Continuar' instead of throwing), meeting the 'no console errors' requirement.

sessions.summary:
Steps 1–3 of the plan are implemented in src/engine/: blocks.js, daynight.js, noise.js, mining.js, inventory.js and crafting.js. `npm run build` passes. `npm test` has 6 of 11 passing; the 5 failing tests all call `createWorld`, `generateChunk`, `buildChunkMesh`, `raycast` or `stepPlayer`, which belong to steps 4–6, so they are expected to fail for now.

Decisions and notes for the other sessions:
- **canHarvest** depends only on the tool requirement, not on whether the block drops. `dropsFor` is what checks for a drop. So `canHarvest(LEAVES, null)` is `true`.
- **Tool speed:** a wooden pickaxe gives speed 2 on any block that has a `tool` requirement, and a stone pickaxe gives 4. This includes iron with a wooden pickaxe, which is harvestable only with the stone one.
- **Crafting** crops the grid to the bounding box of occupied cells and compares ids against the recipe pattern. Item counts are ignored for matching. The glass recipe is shapeless: exactly SAND + COAL in any two cells.
- **Inventory:** `removeFromSlot`, `selectSlot`, `scrollSelection`, `moveStack` and `selectedItem` return the inventory directly. Only `addItem` returns `{ inventory, leftover }`. Out-of-range slots throw `RangeError`.
- **Noise:** `createNoise2D` is a single octave of value noise. Its worst-case change over 0.01 is about 0.042, under the 0.05 bound. Terrain will need to combine octaves in `world.js`.
- **Bash restriction:** the shell was denied once for a combined write-and-node command, so I wrote the files with the Write tool. I did not run ad hoc node checks after that. The `npm test` and `npm run build` runs were allowed.

Steps 4–8 are written. `npm test` passes (11/11) and `npm run build` succeeds. The build doesn't bundle the game code yet, because `src/main.jsx` doesn't import it (step 10). I couldn't open `npm run dev`, so nothing was tested in a browser.

The shell only allowed `npm test` and `npm run build`, so I couldn't run my own scripts. The engine edge cases (physics, sneak at an edge, mesh winding, raycast from inside a block) have only been checked against the visible tests. Review them if the hidden tests matter.

**Engine**
- `world.js`: `generateChunk` takes an optional 4th argument `{ flat }`. Ore and tree placement come only from the seed and coordinates. Edits are kept in a separate map, so chunks can be unloaded without losing them. I added `getChunk` and `unloadChunk` for the renderer.
- `atlas.js` is new. It holds the tile layout shared by the mesher and the UI.
- `mesher.js`, `raycast.js`, `physics.js` follow the spec. `stepPlayer` copies its arrays and never mutates the player. Sprint only applies when `forward` is true.

**Render**
- `src/render/atlas.js` draws the atlas on a canvas with `NearestFilter`, plus icons (`getIconURL`) and 10 crack textures.
- `src/render/chunkManager.js` loads and unloads chunks by distance and builds at most 2 meshes per frame. Edits remesh the changed chunk and its border neighbours.
- `src/render/sky.js` handles sky colour, sun, moon, lights and fog, all driven by `skyState`.

**Game**
- `src/game/game.js` (`createGame`) holds the controls, mining with cracks, placing, middle-click pick, hotbar, F for flying, and the water overlay.
- Esc is handled through `pointerlockchange`. `setScreenOpen(true)` releases the lock without opening the pause menu.
- Double-tap W is the main sprint path; Ctrl+W can't be blocked in Chrome, and a comment says so.
- `src/game/GameCanvas.jsx` is the React wrapper. The game exposes `getSaveData`, `setInventory`, `setPaused`, `setScreenOpen`, `setDebug` and `requestLock`. The callbacks are listed at the top of `game.js`.

**For step 10 (UI, save, `main.jsx`)**
- Passing the seed as a string preserves it through save and load.
- `getSaveData()` returns `{ world, player: { position, yaw, pitch, flying }, inventory, clock }`.
- The UI side of the Esc and inventory rules from the review notes isn't built yet. That covers the cursor stack, returning grid contents to the inventory on close, and opening pause from `onLockLost`.

Step 9 (src/ui/) is written, but nothing imports it yet, and the new files were not compiled.

Files created:
- `src/ui/stacks.js`: pure cursor helpers. `clickStack` picks up, drops, merges up to maxStack, or swaps. `takeResult` refuses when the result doesn't fit the cursor. `setSlot`, `returnStacks` (returns null if anything doesn't fit, so nothing is lost), and `toRows`.
- `src/ui/labels.js`: Portuguese item names via `itemLabel(id)`.
- `src/ui/Slot.jsx`: a div cell with icon from `getIconURL`, count, and optional key hint.
- `src/ui/ContainerScreen.jsx`: shared screen with 36 slots, a cursor stack that follows the mouse, and a square crafting grid (2x2 or 3x3). The result slot calls `craft` and `consumeIngredients`. It is a forwardRef exposing `flush()`, which returns the cursor and grid items to the inventory and calls `onChange`. It returns false and stays open if the inventory is full.
- `src/ui/InventoryScreen.jsx` (2x2, "Inventário") and `src/ui/CraftingTable.jsx` (3x3, "Bancada de trabalho"), both thin wrappers that forward the ref.
- `src/ui/HUD.jsx`: crosshair, 9-slot hotbar with quantities, item name shown for 2 s on slot change, underwater overlay.
- `src/ui/Menu.jsx`: random seed as a string, which is kept as typed (empty becomes random), distance slider 2–8 defaulting to 4, "Novo mundo", and "Continuar" shown only when `hasSave`.
- `src/ui/PauseMenu.jsx`: Continuar, Salvar, Sair, plus a `saveStatus` line.
- `src/ui/DebugOverlay.jsx`: renders the `debugInfo` shape from game.js.
- `src/styles.css`: styling for all of the above.

Contract for step 10 (App and main wiring):
- Import `./styles.css`.
- E and Esc, when a screen is open: call `ref.current.flush()`; close only if it returns true.
- E or the crafting table: call `game.exitLock()` before opening.
- Save and continue: pass `renderDistance` from the Menu callbacks.

Verification: `npm test` passes, 11/11. `npm run build` passes. The UI files are not imported by `main.jsx`, so the build does not compile them. I tried a standalone esbuild check, but the shell denied that compound command, and the feedback loop only allows `npm test` and `npm run build`. Step 10 must import them, and the build will then cover them.

Not done (step 10): `src/game/save.js`, the App/state wiring in `main.jsx`, and `localStorage` handling.

Passo 10 concluído: `npm test` passa (11/11) e `npm run build` termina sem erro. Só o aviso de chunk acima de 500 kB. Não consegui abrir `npm run dev`, então o jogo não foi testado no navegador.

Criei três arquivos e troquei o `src/main.jsx`:
- **`src/game/save.js`**: usa a chave `mc-mvp-save`. `loadSave` e `writeSave` ficam em try/catch, e `loadSave` valida o formato. Save corrompido ou de outra versão devolve `null` e esconde o "Continuar", sem erro no console.
- **`src/App.jsx`**: liga menu, jogo, HUD, pausa, F3, inventário e bancada.
  - **Pausa:** abre pelo `onLockLost`, ou seja, quando o pointer lock cai e não há tela aberta. O Esc com inventário ou bancada aberta fecha a tela; com o jogo pausado, continua. Uma guarda de 300 ms evita que o mesmo Esc feche a pausa que acabou de abrir.
  - **Fechar telas:** devolve ao inventário o cursor e a grade de crafting com `flush`. Se o inventário estiver cheio, a tela continua aberta e nada se perde. O lock volta com um novo pedido logo depois de continuar ou fechar a tela.
  - **Save:** autosave a cada 30 s e ao abrir a pausa. Salvar manual e Sair para o menu também gravam, e o Sair não estava na spec. O "Continuar" restaura mundo, posição, yaw, pitch, voo, inventário e hora, e usa a seed gravada no save, sem alterá-la.
- **`src/main.jsx`**: agora renderiza `App` e importa `src/styles.css`.

O sprint já exigia `forward` na UI e no `stepPlayer`.
